answer_1.quote: In this paper, we employ Minimum Risk Training (MRT) models. Compared to Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), MRT can reduce the gap between training and evaluation, resulting in higher quality translations.
datasets: training-parallel-ep-v8 and rapid2016 sections of WMT17

answer_2.quote: Currently, the most widely used translation evaluation metric is still the n-gram-based BLEU... we select the most mainstream and cutting-edge six metrics for comparison and analysis, including three unsupervised metrics: BLEU, BERTScore, BARTScore, and three supervised metrics: BLEURT, COMET, UniTE.
